name: assign then mutate
code:
a = [1, 2]
b = a
b.append(3)
print(a, b)

name: assign dict then mutate
code:
d = {'x': 1}
e = d
e['y'] = 2
print(d, e)

name: slice copy shallow
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a[:]
b[0].append(2)
print(a, b)

name: copy method shallow
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a.copy()
b[0].append(2)
print(a, b)

name: pass to function mutate
code:
def f(x):
    x.append(3)
a = [1, 2]
f(a)
print(a)

name: pass dict to function mutate
nested function mutates closure
code:
def outer():
    a = []
    def inner():
        a.append(1)
    inner()
    return a
print(outer())

name: return inner container
code:
def make():
    return [[1]]
r = make()
r[0].append(2)
print(r)

name: assign nested element
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a[0]
b.append(2)
print(a, b)

name: two names same list after append
code:
a = [1]
b = a
a.append(2)
print(a, b)

name: list element reassign via alias
code:
a = [1, 2]
b = a
b[0] = 9
print(a, b)

name: function returns same list
code:
def ident(x):
    return x
a = [1]
b = ident(a)
b.append(2)
print(a, b)

name: nested list inside dict via slice
code:
d = {'k': [1]}
e = d.copy()
e['k'].append(2)
print(d, e)

name: set alias
code:
s = {1}
t = s
t.add(2)
print(s, t)

name: function default list accumulates
code:
def acc(x, out=[]):
    out.append(x)
    return out
print(acc(1), acc(2))
